description: Performs a focused attribute read from a known element, such as href, class, aria-*, value, or data-*; use DOM.getAXTree first when the target element is not yet identified.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the target element.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the target element.

id.description: Preferred canonical element ID from DOM.getAXTree.

attribute.description: Attribute name to read, such as "href", "value", or "aria-checked".

purpose.description: Describe why this attribute is needed, e.g., checking a link href, validating aria state, reading an input value, or debugging selector stability
